cohort: The study included very preterm (<=32 weeks gestation) and late preterm (33-36 weeks gestation) infants.
finding: Cognitive, language, and motor development scores were within the normal range for both late preterm and very preterm infants at 12 months of corrected age, with no significant differences between the groups.
